name: Time Blocking
description: Builds a time-blocked weekly schedule from the user's working hours, fixed commitments, and task list. Produces a day-by-day block schedule with task assignments, buffer rules, and energy-level matching. Use when the user asks about time blocking, scheduling their day, creating a weekly plan with specific time slots, or structuring their workday around focused blocks. Do NOT use for prioritizing tasks without scheduling (use eisenhower-matrix or task-prioritization), building a full GTD system (use gtd-workflow), or enterprise team scheduling (use business project-management skills).
